crop.notes: 'Sporting Notes' with three items; only the first is the Allen notice. Others: St. Louis Coursing Club programme and George Kerwin vs. Jerome Quigley at Toronto.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat carried a notice that Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, offered a free concert every night at 619 Market Street, with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, September 24, 1898, page 7. Current summary describes the unrelated Kerwin item, not Allen.

facts.fact: Allen's place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, offered free concerts every night; he was billed as retired champion pugilist of the world
